performance.verdict: Paid channels dark; organic holding but GBP is fading fast.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both show $0. No ROAS or purchase data is possible in this state.
Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completed event recorded — now 14 days overdue.
GBP actions collapsed: last 3 days averaged 3 actions vs prior 3-day average of 23 — a 87% drop, with two consecutive zero-action days (Aug 26–27).
GA4 sessions held steady: last 3 days averaged 268 vs prior 3-day average of 262 — flat, not the +23% the 7d delta implied; no paid traffic driving it.
Purchases and revenue show $0 across all 28 days — likely a Shopify pixel / Meta purchase-event misfire noted in prior context, not zero actual sales.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot 1 immediately — 14 days overdue blocks creative pipeline for paid relaunch.
suggestions.monday_update: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 and has no completion record as of 2026-08-28, making it 14 days overdue. This shoot feeds the real-footage creative that replaces burned-out retargeting assets — paid ads cannot relaunch effectively without it. Sohib to confirm current shoot status with Nacer and set a hard reschedule date. Success check: shoot completed and footage in Drive folder by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: GBP actions hit 0 for 2 straight days after averaging 23/day prior 3-day window — watch for platform data lag before actioning.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero on Aug 26 and Aug 27, against a prior 3-day average of 23 actions/day — an 87% collapse. Before treating this as a listing or visibility problem, confirm whether GBP API reporting has a 48–72 hour lag for this account. If numbers remain at or near zero by 2026-09-01, escalate to Nacer for a GBP listing audit. Success check: actions recover to ≥15/day average by 2026-09-01, or root cause identified.

suggestions.text: Verify Shopify–Meta purchase event pipeline; $0 purchases across 28 days is a confirmed data gap, not a sales verdict.
suggestions.monday_update: Purchase and revenue fields show $0 for all 28 days in the series, consistent with the known Shopify–Meta pixel misfiring issue documented in prior context. Windsor/Meta is the attribution truth source per the SOW. Khurram or the responsible tech owner should run a test purchase and confirm the Meta pixel fires correctly end-to-end. Success check: at least one verified purchase event visible in Meta Events Manager within 48 hours of a test order, confirmed by 2026-08-30.
